{{Short description|none}}
The '''2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages''' were played from 11 July to 28 October 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2023/|title=Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=24 April 2023|access-date=24 April 2023}}</ref> A total of 24 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2023-1.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Sudamericana / Manual de Clubes 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL|access-date=9 March 2023}}</ref> with the final played in [[Maldonado, Uruguay|Maldonado]], Uruguay at [[Estadio Domingo Burgueño]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Deportes/Sudamericana-la-final-se-disputara-en-el-Campus-de-Maldonado-por-pedido-de-Brasil-uc865562|title=Sudamericana: la final se disputará en el Campus de Maldonado por pedido de Brasil |trans-title=Sudamericana: The final will be played at the Maldonado Campus at the request of Brazil|publisher=Portal Montevideo |language=es |date=15 September 2023|access-date=15 September 2023}}</ref>

==Qualified teams==
The winners and runners-up of each of the eight groups in the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana group stage|Copa Sudamericana group stage]] as well as the third-placed teams of each of the eight groups in the [[2023 Copa Libertadores group stage|Copa Libertadores group stage]] advanced to the final stages. The eight Copa Sudamericana group runners-up faced the eight Copa Libertadores group third-placed teams in the knockout round play-offs, whilst the eight Copa Sudamericana group winners directly advanced to the round of 16.

===Seeding===
<section begin=Seeding />
For the final stages, the teams are seeded according to their results in the group stage, with the Copa Sudamericana group winners seeded 1–8, the Copa Sudamericana group runners-up seeded 9–16, and the Copa Libertadores group third-placed teams seeded 17–24. For the round of 16 draw, the seeds 1–8 made up Pot 1, and the eight knockout round play-offs winners (seeds 9–24) made up Pot 2, keeping their seed. Teams from the same association may play each other from the knockout round play-offs onwards.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the knockout round play-offs, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the knockout round play-offs, round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.6). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.5).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 5 July 2023, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]) at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="R16 draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fecha-y-horario-para-los-sorteos-de-los-octavos-de-final/|title=Fecha y horario para los sorteos de los Octavos de Final|trans-title=Date and time for the Round of 16 draws|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=21 June 2023|access-date=21 June 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-cruces-de-octavos-en-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2023/|title=Los cruces de Octavos en la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2023|trans-title=The Round of 16 matchups in the 2023 CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=5 July 2023|access-date=5 July 2023}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a Copa Sudamericana group winner (Pot 1) and a knockout round play-offs winner (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />
